entities.name: Ink-Eyes
entities.description: A legendary nezumi ninja, the most feared ninja on Kamigawa, who killed her ogre mentor and gained necromantic powers from the oni Kuro.

entities.name: Muzan
entities.description: An ogre hermit who took Ink-Eyes as his student and was later killed by her.

entities.name: Kuro
entities.description: An oni overlord who gave Ink-Eyes necromantic powers.

entities.name: Okiba gang
entities.description: A nezumi gang that ostracized Ink-Eyes at a young age.

entities.name: Takenuma swamp
entities.description: A swamp on Kamigawa where Ink-Eyes was left to fend for herself.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: The plane on which Ink-Eyes lived.

events.summary: Ostracized by the Okiba gang, Ink-Eyes is taken deep into the Takenuma swamp and left to fend for herself as punishment.
events.quote: As punishment, she was taken deep into the Takenuma swamp and left to fend for herself.

events.summary: Muzan catches Ink-Eyes stealing from him and takes her in as his student.
events.quote: The ogre saw the ruthless nezumi girl's potential and decided to take her in as his student

events.summary: Ink-Eyes kills Muzan in his sleep and offers his blood to the oni Kuro.
events.quote: she killed her ogre mentor in his sleep and offered his blood to their oni overlord, Kuro

events.summary: Pleased by her treachery, Kuro grants Ink-Eyes necromantic powers, and her eyes turn red.
events.quote: The oni was pleased by her treachery and ambition

relations.note: He took her as his student.
relations.quote: decided to take her in as his student

relations.note: She killed him in his sleep.
relations.quote: she killed her ogre mentor in his sleep

relations.note: She turns the dead into servants for her oni master.
relations.quote: turning them into servants for her oni master
